analysis.content: Nodes 01-03 complete for blavatsky-sd. Key driver note: The Secret Doctrine's commentary on the Stanzas of Dzyan IS the primary text — NOT apparatus to strip. Blavatsky quotes the Dzyan verses (ALL CAPS stanzas) then provides her own commentary citing Puranas, Buddhist texts, Zoroastrian sources. The [[Vol. N, Page M]] markers are inline navigation aids. Full analysis in docs/ingest/decisions/blavatsky-sd.md.
